decisions.reason: The option on particle therapy QA remains valuable while uncertainty about adoption is still unresolved, so it is kept open.
Small-field dosimetry is a growing niche and keeping costs are low, so the option is retained.
Despite overlap with other chamber options, the small-volume segment is still uncertain and holds potential value.
Relative dosimetry remains a key measurement need, and no negative results have emerged to justify abandonment.
The thimble chamber overlaps with established standard chambers already rationalized, and its distinct option value is no longer sufficient to justify continued holding.
